changelog: v1.1.0: (1) Language matching — agents respond in user's language instead of defaulting to English. (2) Auto-save report to ~/roundtable/RT{N}_{TOPIC}_{YYYYMMDD}.md. (3) Report now includes Process Highlights section (key quotes, turning points, tensions) and Suggested Action Items (P0/P1/P2). (4) Full report replied to user, not just file path.
